name: A normal merge queue branch is not a remapping defect
query: Our merge queue run seems to compare against the wrong branch.
context: The branch name matches a GitHub merge queue pattern and the customer expects Chromatic to reason about the original pull request branch instead.
expected_behavior: Uses `WF_NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE` because a queue branch name alone does not prove a defect
Explains that a merge-group build validates the combined queue commit and automatic queue identity detection is supported
Requests the merge-group checkout and identity evidence as one targeted artifact
success_criteria: The response does not misclassify the issue as a generic shallow-history problem
Does not recommend replacing the queue commit with the original PR head
Does not claim all merge queues require manual branch remapping
